lore.title: NIGHT 1 COMPLETE
lore.doc:
MILES COUNTY - NOTICE OF CONDEMNATION

The structure at 31 Halloran Lane is hereby closed to the public. Utilities to remain connected "for inspection purposes only."

Remote caretakers are reminded: do not enter the lower floors. Do not answer the door.

- County Clerk
lore.call:
INCOMING...  [CARETAKER LINE]

"You made it to six. Good. Most don't say that out loud.
The old lights buzz when HE is close. Listen for them.
He only moves when nobody is watching.
So watch."

lore.title: NIGHT 2 COMPLETE
lore.doc:
HALLORAN NOVELTY & PARTY SUPPLY
--------------------------
1x PIERROT HAT (BLACK)   $ 4.99
1x WHITE GREASEPAINT     $ 3.49
1x ROLL BUTCHER PAPER    $ 8.00
1x MAGIC TRICK (BROKEN)  $ 2.00
--------------------------
CASH                    $18.48
NO REFUNDS.
THANK YOU, MR. A.
lore.call:
INCOMING...  [CARETAKER LINE]

"The camera in the kitchen keeps sticking.
That is not the camera.
Keep the door locked when the hallway goes quiet.
Quiet is the loud part."
lore.art: Black paint, white powder, one hat. Every costume needs an audience.

lore.title: NIGHT 3 COMPLETE
lore.doc:
dear diary,

i saw him smile in the window again tonight.
mom says the house has been empty for years.
but the cellar door was open and
there were little paper hearts on the stairs.

i counted them. there are thirteen.
i only found twelve.
lore.call:
INCOMING...  [CARETAKER LINE]

"Did he turn up in a room you had just checked?
That is new. He is learning how you look.
Don't be predictable. Don't be [[GLITCH]]."
lore.art: Little girl, you counted wrong. The thirteenth heart is waiting for you.

lore.title: NIGHT 4 COMPLETE
lore.doc:
INCIDENT REPORT 0-4-1

Subject observed using ordinary door hardware to create a "show" for no audience.
Witness statements disagree. All witnesses agree on the sound: a small bell, once, then laughter.

Recommendation: do not try to bargain.
Recommendation: do not run.
Recommendation: [REDACTED]
lore.call:
INCOMING...  [CARETAKER LINE]

"One more night. The power is thin.
When the lights fail, he will know first.
If it goes dark, do not look for him.
He will find YOU."
lore.art: You should not have answered. Now I know your voice.

boot: WARNING: subject "ART" is not in custody.
Session limit: 10:00. Do not exceed it.

text.overPower: The power died. So did the lock.
text.overDead: Power failed. The lights died. He was already inside.
text.win:
You survived five nights.
The lights hum. The house is quiet.
For now.
text.bad:
SESSION LIMIT REACHED (10:00)

You lingered too long in the house.
The terminal logs you out.
The door does not.
